_about: Mary Wollstonecraft (1759-1797) as author, clean Gutenberg texts: Thoughts on the Education of Daughters (London: J. Johnson, 1787), A Vindication of the Rights of Men, 2nd ed. (London: J. Johnson; the year is not printed in the etext, 1790 inferred), A Vindication of the Rights of Woman (the etext names no printing) and An Historical and Moral View of the French Revolution (London: J. Johnson, 1794). Her translations are on the separate wollstonecraft translator shelf. US public domain. Added in round 2026-10-18ca: the Letters from Sweden, Norway and Denmark (1796), the Posthumous Works edited by Godwin (1798) and the letters to Imlay, clean Gutenberg. Not taken: Gutenberg 26590, a second copy of the Rights of Woman; her fiction (Maria, Mary) and the Original Stories for children. No uids minted.
